newsitem.title: USA: Beacon Properties closes building purchases.
newsitem.headline: Beacon Properties closes building purchases.

text.p: Beacon Properties Corp said it closed 11 office building acquisitions worth $253 million.

The company paid for the office buildings, located in Los Angeles and the greater Boston area, with the $422 million of proceeds from a 13.7 million common stock offering it completed on November 14. It also used the proceeds to pay off the $118 million outstanding balance on its $300 million credit facility, a company spokesman said.
The company placed the offering's remaining proceeds -- $51 million -- in its cash coffer, he added.
So far this year, Beacon has spent nearly $1 billion to acquire 55 office buildings and will seek additional acquisitions in 1997, the spokesman said.
The company's mortgage debt totals $558.3 million.
